Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a factual error in its initial hypothesis by incorrectly identifying Matilda Lutz as an "Italian model and actress." Matilda Lutz is actually an American actress (born in New York City) who is the daughter of German actor and director Jürgen Lutz. While she has German heritage, she is not Italian. This incorrect premise led the subsequent steps to confirm the movie title and director (which were correct) but based the final answer on a false attribute regarding the actress's nationality.
